labelling_rule: spine: the one journey the brief's final action serves (acceptable set listed when two are defensible). direction: acceptable set = directions whose mood does not contradict the business/audience (fixed before calling). role r: TRUE iff the brief itself supplies the content the code's KIND_NEEDS line demands (pricing: states prices/plans; testimonials: quotes customers or names clients; team: names the people; blog: names articles/posts/updates; timeline: gives milestones/roadmap/dated releases; faq: answers visitor questions; logo-wall: names clients or partners; plan-comparison: compares plans). X = ambiguous, excluded. Real pipeline includes a role iff 1-P(none) >= 0.5. Labels written before any Jev call.

B1.brief: Law firm Hartley & Moss in Leeds: employment law for small businesses. Visitors should phone or fill in the enquiry form. Partners: Anna Hartley and Dev Moss. Fixed-fee first consultation: 150 pounds.

B2.brief: Lattice, a SaaS for scheduling shifts. Plans: Free, Pro $12, Business $40. Customers include Acme Co and Brightlane. Visitors start a free trial.

B3.brief: Online shop selling hand-thrown ceramics: mugs, bowls, planters. Free delivery over 40 pounds. No reviews yet, no blog, no stockists to name.

B4.brief: A directory of independent bike mechanics across Scotland, where cyclists search by town and read each mechanic's profile.

B5.brief: A weekly newsletter on urban planning. Latest posts: 'Why parking minimums fail', 'The case for 15-minute streets', 'Tram lines of Lyon'. Readers subscribe by email.

B6.brief: A 6-week evening course on beginner Spanish. Weeks: 1 Greetings, 2 Food, 3 Travel, 4 Past tense, 5 Shopping, 6 Review. Tutor Marisol Vega. Enrol online.

B7.brief: Restaurant Osteria Bruno: reservations by phone or form, open Tuesday to Sunday. Frequently asked: do you take large groups (yes, up to 14), is there parking (street only), do you have vegan dishes (yes).

B8.brief: A signed-in expense tracker for freelancers: upload receipts, categorise them, export for tax. No marketing site needed, just the app shell and a login.

B9.brief: Harbor Aid, a refugee charity. Donate or volunteer. UNHCR, Oxfam and Shelter UK fund our work. Milestones: founded 2011, first shelter 2014, new shelter 2024.

B10.brief: A photographer's studio site. We have no testimonials and no clients we can name, no pricing online (quote on request), and no team. Visitors contact by email to commission shoots.

B11.brief: Notely, an AI note app. User quotes: 'Saved me hours' - Priya S.; 'Finally my meetings make sense' - Tom R. FAQ: Does it work offline? Yes. Is data encrypted? Yes. Start free.

B12.brief: A coworking space in Bristol: day passes, monthly desks, meeting-room booking. Tour booking form. Members include Kiln Studio and Fernwood Design.

B13.brief: A loud art collective in Berlin. Manifesto page, past shows, contact. Rebellious tone, big type. Members: Jonas, Ilse, Kofi and Rin.

B14.brief: Open-source CLI 'fastgrep' with docs, an install guide and a changelog: v1.2 in March, v1.1 in January. Source on GitHub. Works with VS Code, Vim and Emacs.

B15.brief: Landing page for a pop-up coffee cart. Find us on Saturdays at the Greenmarket.

B16.brief: Online yoga classes. Memberships: Monthly 29 pounds, Annual 249 pounds (save 15 percent). Compare: Monthly includes live classes; Annual adds the recorded library and workshops.
